description: This file defines a singleton object 'CalculationHistory' that manages an in-memory, application-wide persistent store for calculator expressions and results. It provides methods to add entries, retrieve the current history, and clear the history, designed for use in a modern UI panel.

classes.name: HistoryEntry
classes.description: A data class representing a single calculation entry, including the expression, result, and timestamp.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new calculation (expression and result) to the history, removing the oldest entry if the maximum size is exceeded.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns a list of all calculation history entries, with the most recent first.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the calculation history.
